scope: Installed VSIX in Production extension mode across six separate VS Code launches. A pending approval survives the first window exit; a managed file transaction continues after the extension host is killed. Calls use the same validated request dispatcher as the Webview; this is not pointer/keyboard UI automation, managed-worker crash recovery, or model-quality evidence.
provider: Explicit deterministic local stdio fixture; no external AI inference or credentials used.
dependencyEnvironment: Synthetic repository outside the host checkout with no third-party dependencies. Checks use Node's built-in test runner through the real package-manager verification path.
